notes: Copy for Check It, from the Check It Build Brief (Nov 20) and the Workflow Screens. Phone numbers are NANPA fictional (555-0100 to 555-0199). Keep every number in this file as (613) 555-0142 until the team picks a real line.

talk.heading: Talk to a person
talk.note: Sample number for this student project. In real use, this would call the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre, Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 4:45 p.m. Eastern.

report.heading: Report it
report.note: Sample number for this student project. In real use, this would call the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.

general_step.text: Don't reply, click or pay. Contact the person or company using a number or website you already know.

still_personal: Some personal details may still show. We didn't keep them.

strong.heading: Strong warning signs
strong.body_known: This looks like a common scam: {tactic}.
strong.body_unknown: This looks like a common scam.

some.heading: Some warning signs
some.body: Some parts of this are often used in scams.

none_found.heading: No common warning signs found
none_found.body: That doesn't prove it's genuine. If it asks for money or details, check first.

screens.home_note: See if a text, email or call looks like a scam
screens.finished_line: Got a real message you're unsure about?
screens.locked_heading: Check It opens after your test session
screens.locked_body: Check It opens after your test session. You can still talk to a person.
screens.choose_privacy: Personal details are hidden on your phone before anything is sent.
screens.photo_note: Of a text, email or letter
screens.call_note: Answer a few questions about it
screens.photo_help: Show just the message, one screen at a time. A closer picture reads best.
screens.paste_help: Copy the message first, then tap Paste from my phone. Your phone may ask you to tap Paste.
screens.paste_too_long: That message is long. Please copy just the part that worries you.
screens.ready_body: Getting ready. This can take a few minutes the first time. Next time it will be quicker.
screens.ready_slow: Still working. You can also describe it instead.
screens.hiding_heading: Hiding personal details on your phone
screens.review_help: Black boxes hide personal details. Tap any word to hide it or show it.
screens.review_help_text: Words in square brackets are hidden. Tap any word to hide it or show it.
screens.review_group_rest: Tap any word to hide it too
screens.confirm_show: Show this detail? It will be sent to be checked.
screens.send_note: A copy of your message with personal details hidden is sent to Anthropic's Claude to be checked. It is not stored by us.
screens.call_stop_confirm: Leave? Your answers won't be kept.
screens.review_none_auto: We didn't find personal details to hide. Please look through the words below.

unreadable.heading: We couldn't read the picture
unreadable.body: We couldn't read the words in this picture. A clearer or closer photo may help.

offline.heading: No connection
offline.body: Your phone isn't connected to the internet right now. Nothing was sent.

too_many.heading: Too many checks today
too_many.body: You've done a lot of checks today. Please try again tomorrow, or talk to a person now.

wrong.heading: Something went wrong
wrong.body: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was kept.

call_questions.text: Did the caller say someone in your family is in trouble or hurt?
Did they say they were from your bank, the police or the government?
Did they ask you to pay, send money, or buy gift cards?
Did they tell you to keep it secret or stay on the line?
Did they ask to connect to your computer or phone?
Did they offer to get back money you lost, for a fee?
